ns2:section.sectionText: Enrollment restricted to Psychology seniors and juniors through April 16. Psychology seniors have priority through April 10. Psychology juniors may begin registering for this lab course on April 11. Non-Psychology students will be able to enroll after April 20. This section focuses on human learning and memory. Students will participate in 3-4 experiments designed by the instructors and work in pairs during the final portion of the course to develop, implement, and report an experiment of their own conceptualization.
